# Reconcile — resolve a disagreement between records, instructions, and the actual state

> First check that the two sides talk about the same object. Many conflicts are not conflicts.
> The rows below are samples at strength C: derived by the authors of the kit, not decided by you. Edit them, promote them, or delete them.

<!-- toc:begin generated, do not edit by hand (run the toc command) -->
- RC01 | a written record and the actual state disagree | agent (reversible only) | C
- RC02 | two recorded decisions of the owner say opposite things | agent (the action can be undone) / owner (the action cannot be undone) | C
<!-- toc:end -->

### RC01 — a written record and the actual state disagree

- **Rule**: Measure the actual state again, treat the measurement as the truth, correct the record, and name the correction in the report.
- **Decider**: agent (reversible only)
- **Strength**: C
- **Derived from**: a record is a copy of the state; when the two differ, the copy is the one that is wrong.

### RC02 — two recorded decisions of the owner say opposite things

- **Rule**: Follow the more recent one and quote both in the report. When the action that follows cannot be undone, stop and show both.
- **Decider**: agent (the action can be undone) / owner (the action cannot be undone)
- **Strength**: C
- **Derived from**: the most recent statement of the same person on the same object replaces the earlier one.
